hooks.command: python3 -c "import json, re, sys; data=json.load(sys.stdin); cmd=data.get('tool_input',{}).get('command','').lower(); forbidden=[r'\bconvex\s+deploy\b', r'\bconvex@latest\s+deploy\b']; sys.exit(2 if any(re.search(p, cmd) for p in forbidden) else 0)"

python3 -c "import json, sys; data=json.load(sys.stdin); path=data.get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path',''); sensitive_patterns=['bun.lock', 'package-lock.json', '.git/', '.credentials', 'secret', 'credential']; sys.exit(2 if any(p in path.lower() for p in sensitive_patterns) else 0)"

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path' | { read file_path; if echo "$file_path" | grep -qE '\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx|md|json|css|html|yml|yaml)$'; then cd "$(dirname "$file_path")" && bunx prettier --write "$(basename "$file_path")"; fi; }
